reason: Both methods perform identical logic: they iterate from index 0 up to length-1 of the first array, compare corresponding elements, and return false on the first mismatch, otherwise true. They neither check for nullity of the second array nor compare the last element or array lengths. Consequently, for any pair of input arrays (including nulls and arrays of different lengths), the two methods exhibit the same behavior. No deterministic, bounded input can distinguish them.
